title.zh: Liquid AI发布超低延迟推理引擎，瞄准搜索、广告和支付风控
title.en: Liquid AI发布超低延迟推理引擎，瞄准搜索、广告和支付风控

current_state.zh: Liquid AI launched RIPL, a real-time inference engine for its small language models that it says completes 95% of requests in 34.6ms at 1,000 QPS on a single NVIDIA B200 — about 14.4x faster than Qwen3.5-0.8B served with vLLM — targeting search ranking, ad matching and payment risk control.
